Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, TLS completeness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced; retained implementation failures are containment signals only. Compliance is technical-only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. No certificate is reported expiring within 30 days, but complete TLS posture is not established. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates and permit only bounded reversible work that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, and data boundaries. Continue existing read-only evidence capture; do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, or conduct external outreach.
